title: "Data & Code"
---

I share the data and analysis code behind my research openly, following FAIR principles. Most of my datasets are on [Zenodo](https://zenodo.org) and [OSF](https://osf.io), and my code is on [GitHub](https://github.com/cipaolini).

## Tools I work with

**Distributional & neural models:** Nephosem, word2vec, fastText; transformer models and LLMs via Hugging Face (inference, embedding extraction, systematic prompting, evaluation-set construction)

**NLP pipelines:** spaCy, Stanza and UDPipe for Italian, French and English

**Statistics & visualization:** R (lme4, party, Rtsne, tidyverse), Python (scikit-learn, SciPy, matplotlib, PyTorch, UMAP)

**Formats & standards:** XML, TEI, CoNLL, SQL; reproducible reports with Quarto and R Markdown
